messages:
marta-evans: Heads-up — OrbitalPay activity tanked overnight, MAU -60% in last week. Noticed a seat cluster with zero events. dashboard: https://redwood.app/d/usage/orbitalpay
ashok-singh: any infra/billing red flags?
eng-bot: Alert: auth-5xx spike detected 2026-03-20T11:12:02Z (~4x baseline). trace_id=abc123
jordan_ng: timeline looks like drop started 2026-03-14. procurement note: 'shortlist vendors' around that date. also saw their cto-lead exit last week per notes.
marta-evans: that advocate leaving explains sudden inactivity. we should prioritize retention play.
lisa-csm: i'll take lead on outreach. proposed plan: 1) quick ops check, 2) offer 2-week dedicated trial + modest credits, 3) set meeting with new eng lead. drafting email.
ashok-singh: ops checked — infra healthy except the auth 5xx spike. query for inactive users: ```SELECT user_id, last_active FROM events WHERE account = 'orbitalpay' AND last_active < now() - interval '14 days';```
jordan_ng: i'll prep a short micro-benchmark (latency + token cost) to run in the trial env. low lift, high signal to counter competitor claims.
lisa-csm: draft email below, feedback welcome:
> Hi <Name>,
>
> We noticed a drop in activity for your team and wanted to check in. Would you be open to a quick 20m call to understand what changed? We'd also like to offer a short dedicated trial so we can run a focused latency/cost demo for your new eng lead.
>
> Available Tue/Thu mornings PT. — Lisa (CSM)

marta-evans: fine by me. i'll loop AE + AM once email finalized.
nashok-singh: i'll provision the dedicated trial env and reserved tokens. AE/legal need to approve credits; i'll ping them after.
jordan_ng: will run candidate model variants and share numbers by EOD.
lisa-csm: meeting scheduled 2026-03-22 10:00 PT with new-eng-lead@orbitalpay.com + procurement. will post notes after.
marta-evans: thanks everyone. we'll aim to surface clear cost/latency gains in the trial and capture any competitive objections on the call.
notes: playbook: retention-offer, micro-benchmark, AE/legal credit approval
